note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 crop is soft: barrel and slotted grey panel edges are smeared and little new detail beyond the 64px original (detail_gain 5.6).
flags.fix: Re-run with a crisper edge pass on the barrel and panel outlines and add fine steel grain inside the panel; keep the alpha mask as is.

flags.problem: Wood grain and the black bolt hole are soft at 1:1; the hole has a blurred halo and the plank streaks are faint, reading as smoothed.
flags.fix: Sharpen the hole edge and add crisper plank grain at 1:1; keep the warm brown and plank direction.
